We use the cofactor expansion along the first row:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(U) & ={u}_{11}{C}_{11}+{u}_{12}{C}_{12}+{u}_{13}{C}_{13}+{u}_{14}{C}_{14} \\  & =5\cdot {C}_{11}+(-2)\cdot {C}_{12}+0\cdot {C}_{13}+0\cdot {C}_{14} \\  & =5{C}_{11}-2{C}_{12} \\  & =5\cdot |\begin{aligned}5 & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ \\ ∗ & 0 & 1 & 0 \\ ∗ & 6 & 0 & 1 \\ ∗ & 2 & 5 & -4\end{aligned}|+(-2)\cdot |\begin{aligned}∗ & -2 & ∗ & ∗ \\ 0 & ∗ & 1 & 0 \\ 3 & ∗ & 0 & 1 \\ -3 & ∗ & 5 & -4\end{aligned}| \\  & =5\cdot (-1)^{1+1}|\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 0 \\ 6 & 0 & 1 \\ 2 & 5 & -4\end{aligned}|+(-2)\cdot (-1)^{1+2}|\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 0 \\ 3 & 0 & 1 \\ -3 & 5 & -4\end{aligned}| \\  & =5|\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 0 \\ 6 & 0 & 1 \\ 2 & 5 & -4\end{aligned}|+2|\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 0 \\ 3 & 0 & 1 \\ -3 & 5 & -4\end{aligned}| \\  & =5(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ 5 & -4\end{aligned}|-1\cdot |\begin{aligned}6 & 1 \\ 2 & -4\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}6 & 0 \\ 2 & 5\end{aligned}|)+2(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ 5 & -4\end{aligned}|-1\cdot |\begin{aligned}3 & 1 \\ -3 & -4\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}3 & 0 \\ -3 & 5\end{aligned}|) \\  & =5(0-(6\cdot (-4)-1\cdot 2)+0)+2(0-(3\cdot (-4)-1\cdot (-3))+0) \\  & =5\cdot 26+2\cdot 9 \\  & =130+18 \\  & =148\end{aligned}
$$
